name: alxpro-theme
description: Black-and-white dark and light themes for web development, with matching colors for eight terminals.

walkthroughs.title: AlxPro Theme
walkthroughs.description: Black and white, for web development. Pick a theme, follow your system, set the font, and match your terminal.

steps.title: Pick dark or light
steps.description:
AlxPro Dark and AlxPro Light are installed.
[Choose a theme](command:workbench.action.selectTheme)

media.altText: ALXPRO THEME, in large letters fading from the text color

steps.title: Follow your system's appearance
steps.description:
Switch between AlxPro Dark and AlxPro Light when your system does. Turn on **Auto Detect Color Scheme**, then set the preferred dark and light themes.
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22window.autoDetectColorScheme%22%5D)

media.altText: ALXPRO THEME, in large letters fading from the text color

steps.title: Use Geist Mono
steps.description:
The themes are drawn with Geist Mono in mind. Install it, then set it as the editor font: `'Geist Mono', monospace`.
[Set the font](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22editor.fontFamily%22%5D)

media.altText: ALXPRO THEME, in large letters fading from the text color

steps.title: Match your terminal
steps.description:
Run this in Terminal.app, iTerm2, Ghostty, Warp, WezTerm, Kitty or Alacritty to install the theme for it:
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/al-xpro/alxpro-theme/main/install.sh | bash`
[Every terminal](https://github.com/al-xpro/alxpro-theme#terminals)

media.altText: ALXPRO THEME, in large letters fading from the text color

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build && npm run check
